title: OpenAI’s GPT-6 guide puts workload fit ahead of maximum capability
friendlyTitle: How to choose the right GPT-6 model for a job
summary: OpenAI published a production guide for choosing among GPT-6 Astra, GPT-6.1 Sol and GPT-6 Luna, with advice on reasoning effort, latency, prompt caching, compaction and long-running agent workflows. The guide recommends measuring task success, latency and cost per successful task rather than defaulting to the largest model.
friendlySummary: OpenAI explains when to use its strongest, middle and faster GPT-6 models. It also covers ways to reduce cost and keep long AI jobs on track.
whyItMatters: For builders, model selection is now an operating decision rather than a leaderboard decision. Matching capability and reasoning effort to the job can reduce cost and delay while keeping stronger models available for the work that needs them.
friendlyWhyItMatters: The biggest model is not always the best choice. A smaller model can be quicker and cheaper for clear, repeated tasks.
